text:
maria_support: heads up — ACME reported a retention issue. Objects with TTL=30d still showing up in search and accessible via the API after 35 days. ticket C-7421.
acme_ops: confirm — we ran a search for `user:acme org:acme-bucket created:<2025-01-01` and got results that should have been purged. Notably the object metadata shows deleted=false.
aj_dev: can you paste the exact query + one object id? also which environment (prod/dedicated) and region?
acme_ops: query and one id: `GET /v1/objects?owner=org:acme-bucket&created_before=2025-01-01` -> returned `obj_9a3f2c`. This is on prod-us-east.
maria_support: Audit log for that object shows last retention state change at 2025-01-01T03:12:00Z -> should have entered deletion queue on 2025-01-01T03:15:00Z per policy.
noah_sre: I'm seeing purge-worker logs around that time. There's a 503 from storage-gateway then a retry, then success recorded for the purge job, but index still has the doc. Pasting excerpt:
```
2025-01-01T03:15:07Z purge-worker[pid=121] INFO enqueuing purge obj_9a3f2c
2025-01-01T03:15:09Z storage-gateway ERROR 503 ServiceUnavailable write failed
2025-01-01T03:15:12Z purge-worker WARN retrying purge obj_9a3f2c (attempt=2)
2025-01-01T03:15:15Z storage-gateway INFO 200 OK delete accepted
2025-01-01T03:15:16Z purge-worker INFO marked purged in purge-log obj_9a3f2c
```
aj_dev: curious — if purge-log shows marked purged, but index still returns, likely an index-delete async job failed or missed. Does the indexer poll the purge-log?
kms-bot: info — KMS key for org:acme rotated 2025-01-01T02:58:00Z. No errors reported during rotation.
noah_sre: I can see indexer consumer checkpoint lagged at ~00:02:00 during that window and then jumped. There are rare cases where indexer skips a purge-log entry if it cannot decrypt metadata (rotation windows). Looking into decryption errors in indexer logs.
aj_dev: can you grep indexer logs for obj_9a3f2c and for 'decrypt' errors? Also confirm if purge-log entry had the expected tombstone flag.
noah_sre: grep results: `indexer[pid=88] ERROR decrypt failed for metadata obj_9a3f2c: key not found` — looks like a short-lived key cache miss after rotation. The purge-log entry is present but indexer could not validate signature, so it skipped tombstone write.
maria_support: customer is asking for timeline and whether data was ever copied off-platform. Legal asked me to cc @legal_jones.
legal_jones: important — need confirmation data was not exported. If index still returns but storage shows deleted, that's a controlled exposure window. Please get full audit log slice and verify S3 access logs.
acme_ops: we do not see any external download events for obj_9a3f2c. Only internal delete attempts in logs.
aj_dev: next steps: 1) run reconciliation to re-drive tombstone for any purge-log entries where indexer failed due to KMS cache miss (I can run a one-off job), 2) add a short-lived backoff and re-fetch KMS keys in indexer when decrypt fails, 3) produce timeline and send to legal + customer.
maria_support: thanks. aj, can you run the re-drive and confirm? I'm going to put this on high-priority escalation and update the ticket. :eyes:
aj_dev: will run re-drive now and post results in thread. estimate 30m.
noah_sre: I'll collect indexer logs (decrypt failures) and S3 access logs for the timeframe and drop in the ticket.
kms-bot: note — rotated key version v20250101-02 is active. Older versions retained for 48 hours.
aj_dev: done — re-drive job completed, tombstone re-applied, index removed obj_9a3f2c at 2025-01-01T04:02:10Z. Posting script output: `reconcile --since=2025-01-01T03:00Z --fix` -> 1/1 fixed.
maria_support: confirmed with ACME that object no longer appears in search. sending timeline to legal now. Closing loop after legal review. :white_check_mark:
